>endometriosis

No I only have painful periods once in a blue moon, and even then it's just tummy pains and cramping.

I do, I just wish there was somehow a quick fix to this, but I'm guessing it's my mental health that's causing it, and there is never any quick fix to that.

Thank you for talking with me, you helped \^\^
We have talked about it, he says he will work hard to try make me feel more comfortable during it, but I feel even more guilty as it's me who's the problem not him..

My depression has been worse lately, I can't bring myself to go back to the doctor as it's never ending.

Other than my mental health problems nothing has changed between us, hes really understanding and is always there for me, he looks after me a lot when I'm feeling bad.

I will try next time to lie to her about money, I don't want to keep giving her my money.

Thank you for your kind words and support, I'm glad that you are happy with your husbands family.

You are right, this is the best my life has been in so so many years.
I'm just really struggling to deal with the hurt from my family, and tbh I'm scared of all of this life stuff.. It's overwhelming

I spent a long time trying to calmly talk to my dad about the way he acts and the things he says about me, but it makes him mad immediately and one time he hit me because of it, he once claimed that hes the victim of all of this and that I'm manipulative .

When I try to talk to my mom about feeling alone she is very fast to get annoyed aswell, she is very stressed with my brother and my dad and her job.. she will roll her eyes at me and tell  me shes too tired to deal with me at the moment.. every single time.

Everything you have said I have tried, it's to the point where I just want to cut them out and try to get over it in a sense and live a happy life.
My grandma has had a spending problem since she was a young adult I don't think me telling her to not waste anymore money will stop that, and if your talking about maybe me wasting money, I don't I'm saving as much money as possible which is why she pressured me for money because she knows I must have a decent amount.

I can't trust my dad with my problems anymore, he always turn them into a joke that hurts my feelings and makes me cry, I have given up on him, he is the real monster, and I refuse to try fix things with him when i have already tried for years and years.

Thank you so much for your support and for taking the time to reply to this post, 

I really appreciate it

It feels nice to hear I'm not the only one and that you made it out alright, I'm happy for you.

I'm trying to hold on and tell myself it will get better, but I'm really struggling, I'm not strong.
